name: Robbery
overview: Scripture clearly condemns robbery as a grave offense against both God and neighbor, emphasizing that it is forbidden and abhorred by the Lord, who loves justice and hates robbery (Isaiah 61:8). Robbery is associated with deceit, exploitation, and violence, as seen in Leviticus 19:13 and Ezekiel 18:10, and those who engage in it face severe consequences, including death (Ezekiel 18:13). The biblical narrative also records instances of robbery to illustrate its destructive impact on individuals and communities (Judges 9:25; Proverbs 21:7), underscoring the necessity of righteous judgment and the possibility of forgiveness for those who repent.
